# LargeDeviationTopologicalOrder

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of large deviation principles to quantify the exponential decay rates of rare events (e.g., gap closings) in finite topological systems. Enables prediction of failure probabilities in small-scale topological devices, critical for reliable TCC hardware and iNEST-inspired fault-tolerant architectures.
